Orchestrator listens for signals across Chili Piper and external tools, decides what should happen next, and takes the action itself. description:
Wir bei SoSafe haben das Ziel, der führende Anbieter für Human Risk Management Lösungen in Europa zu werden. Als Mid-Market Account Executive (m/w/d) wirst du Teil eines dynamischen, ambitionierten und internationalen Teams von Account Executives, das auf Zusammenarbeit, täglichen Wissensaustausch und die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Vertriebsprozessen setzt. Du entscheidest mit dem CFO, welche fünfzehn Kennzahlen sein Unternehmen künftig steuern.

Montag: Kick-off bei einem Maschinenbauer mit 400 Mitarbeitenden. Auf dem Tisch liegen DATEV, ein ERP, ein CRM, eine Zeiterfassung — und die Frage, warum die Geschäftsführung sechs Wochen nach Monatsende noch keine belastbare Deckungsbeitragsrechnung hat. Freitag: eine priorisierte Liste von Use Cases, eine Roadmap in Wellen, die ersten Kennzahlendefinitionen abgestimmt.

In anderen Tech-Unternehmen heißt dieselbe Arbeit Deployment Strategist, Value Engineer oder Client Value Partner.

ValueWorks ist eine Decision-Intelligence-Plattform für Geschäftsführungen, CFOs und Private-Equity-Investoren im deutschsprachigen Raum. Wir verbinden die Daten aus den Systemen, die unsere Kunden ohnehin haben, in einem semantischen Layer zu einem konsistenten Bild des Unternehmens — und machen daraus Steuerung: Reporting, Diagnose, Planung, OKR. Gegründet wurde ValueWorks von einem Team aus McKinsey, Bain und SAP — mit entsprechend viel Erfahrung darin, wie Unternehmen tatsächlich gesteuert werden und woran Steuerung in der Praxis scheitert.

Priorisierung nach Wichtigkeit und Umsetzbarkeit, daraus schneidest du die Umsetzungswellen.

Kennzahlen definieren: Du bringst Finance und Fachbereich zu einer gemeinsamen Definition von „Auftragseingang" oder „DSO" und übersetzt sie so, dass sie im semantischen Layer eindeutig umsetzbar ist. Der anspruchsvollste und wertvollste Teil der Arbeit.

title: Senior Business Intelligence Lead (all genders)
description:
Your Mission

EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question. 
This role addresses the problem - not by building more dashboards, but by creating a shared and trustworthy data foundation. The goal is to establish clear definitions and consistent metrics so that teams and leadership can make informed decisions based on the same numbers. Someone who understands that unclear definitions, rather than a lack of data, are often the real problem can make a significant impact in this role. You own the certified layer, the single, agreed upon version of every core metric that reev runs on. You connect the definition, the data model, and the delivery. And when two numbers disagree, you are the person who says which one to trust. 

What you will do 

  • Define core metrics with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Engineering, and Platform.
  • Agree on definitions, data contracts, and ownership forcore metrics with the teams that own them.
  • Maintain and verify the certified data layer, built in ETL tooland surfaced in Metabase, so teams can build their own dashboards on top of it.
  • Use SQL to validate data, investigate inconsistencies, and trace numbers back to their sources.
  • Work with Platform team to identify potential improvements in data flows, pipelines, and transformations, advise on next steps, and help prioritize next steps during planning.

About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

More fleets are choosing Flock and our Customer Success team needs to grow. You will own a book of customers outright: onboarding them, keeping them engaged with their data, and getting them to renewal in better shape than they started. The role is built around the conversations our telematics makes possible, from quarterly reviews with fleet managers to safety interventions that follow a spike in risky driving, alongside a steady variety of inbound queries by phone and email. You hear first hand what matters to customers and brokers, and your suggestions for improving how we work carry real weight. AI is part of the day job too, because Flock runs on it. You will use it to prepare for meetings, dig into fleet data and stay on top of your book. You do not need insurance experience. You need the service instincts that make clients want to deal with you, and the appetite to learn everything else.
